outline:
本課程主要教授內容有：(1)人與環境、(2)生態學基礎、(3)生態學在環境保護中之應用、(4)人口的增長與控制、(5)糧食問題、(6)能源與環境問題、(7)水資源與水污染、(8)空氣資源與空氣污染、(9)土壤污染與有害廢棄物、(10)農業資源與保育、(11)野生植物與動物、(12)近代的都市環境、(13)地球環境問題　。
The main teaching content of this course is: (1) People and the environment, (2) Basics of ecology, (3) Application of ecology in environmental protection, (4) Population growth and control, (5) Food issues, (6 ) Energy and environmental issues, (7) Water resources and water pollution, (8) Air resources and air pollution, (9) Soil pollution and hazardous waste, (10) Agricultural resources and conservation, (11) Wild plants and animals, (12) Modern urban environment, (13) Global environmental issues.
